title: Penthouse Magazine December 1994 Heidi Fleiss Special Holiday Issue
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, December 1994 Special Holiday Issue. Featured: "The Nudes of Heidi Fleiss: A Lover's Intimate Portrait," "The Great U.F.O. Cover-Up," "Cyberslut Confessions: Interactive Groupies Who Get You Off — On Line," plus South Africa in Peril, a holiday gift guide, and Penthouse Comix.
Complete issue, no missing pages. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
